recognitionRules: Use navy table headings and pale working rows.
Keep amber cells for editable schedule inputs.
Align time and venue fields consistently across the planner.
Retain visible validity and conflict states, with text labels as well as color.
Preserve the source conditional state colors and accompanying labels only when their recorded condition applies; do not turn exception, venue or validation colors into universal logo accents.
Keep the Hall blue, Studio green and Courtyard tan booking cells distinct; mark conflicts in pink with red text, and outside-hours entries in yellow.

rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use PROGRAMME DESK in Arial with three offset horizontal timetable rules. No clock face or checkmark.
invariants: Use navy table headings and pale working rows.
Keep amber cells for editable schedule inputs.
Align time and venue fields consistently across the planner.
adaptations: A public schedule removes internal planning fields while preserving time and place.
A monochrome export retains validity labels.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
